notes.title: A slow read of “Neural Networks Are Already Clean”
notes.description: Section-by-section notes on Nick Cammarata's essay arguing that polysemanticity in neural networks was misread, with background for physicists and small reproductions: the Toy Models of Superposition phase diagram and a readers-instead-of-reconstruction variant, and a direct check of the famous cat-and-car neuron on the original InceptionV1 weights.
